name: Anna
source:
Anna or Annie, is a Fell agent, who successfully infiltrated [url=https://vndb.org/c165606]Countess Tabitha[/url]'s security measures. Tabitha's ability to discover the Fell has frustrated the Fell leadership. Annie has no unique abilities and has managed to worm her way in to Tabitha's personal service. Annie's fate is currently unknown as her messages ceased some time ago.
